subject.title: fix(ui): add AbortSignal.timeout to nostr profile fetch calls

question: Should Nostr profile operations retain the current main 30-second timeout behavior, or should OpenClaw intentionally shorten that user-visible deadline to 15 seconds?
rationale: The central hang-prevention behavior already exists on current main, but choosing a shorter deadline changes when a slow profile publish/import becomes an error and is not established by the supplied evidence.

options.title: Keep the current 30-second behavior
options.body: Close or withdraw this duplicate branch and retain the existing timeout message and retry flow on current main.

options.title: Adopt a 15-second deadline deliberately
options.body: Rebase a narrow change that updates the current timeout policy, tests the exact value, and proves profile form recovery against a live Gateway.

recommendation.title: Keep the current 30-second behavior
recommendation.body: Close or withdraw this duplicate branch and retain the existing timeout message and retry flow on current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied timeline provides the only direct maintainer-routing signal for this Nostr profile surface.
